raw_sections.summary:
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Results-driven Implementation and Conversion Lead with 13+ years of experience delivering complex projects in Banking, Payments, FinTech, Fraud Management, and SaaS domains. Extensive expertise in card transaction lifecycle, payment switches, data field mapping, interface requirements analysis, and end-to-end conversion project delivery. Deep knowledge of FIS systems, banking industry operations, and industry-specific terminology across multiple verticals. Project Management Professional (PMP) Certified and Certified Scrum Master (CSM), with a strong record of independent judgement, team mentoring, strategic planning participation, and developing standards and guidelines for staff. Effective communicator across all levels of technical and non-technical personnel.
raw_sections.skills:
CORE COMPETENCIES

Implementation and Conversion: End-to-end project delivery, data field mapping, interface requirements analysis, system configuration
Banking and Payments Domain: Card transaction lifecycle, payment switches, fraud management, chargebacks, credit operations, dispute resolution
FIS Systems: Advanced knowledge of FIS applications, banking industry relationships, and industry-specific operational standards
Project and Program Management: High-complexity project management, risk identification, mitigation planning, timeline adherence
Agile and Scrum (CSM Certified): Sprint planning, backlog grooming, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives, Agile coaching
Stakeholder Management: Client calls, executive communication, escalation resolution, account status reporting ● Process Development: Standards, guidelines, SOPs, process documentation, staff education and mentoring ● Tools: Jira, Confluence, Vision Plus, ServiceNow (familiar), Agile dashboards, CRM platforms ● Communication: Client-facing email management, facilitating client calls, written and verbal communication across all levels
ADDITIONAL SKILLS AND KEYWORDS
Implementation | Conversion | FIS | Banking | Payments | Fraud Management | Card Transaction Lifecycle | Payment Switches | Data Mapping | Interface Requirements | Project Management | PMP | Agile | Scrum | Scrum Master | Sprint Planning | Stakeholder Management | Client Communication | ServiceNow | Jira | Confluence | Vision Plus | Risk Mitigation | Process
Improvement | SOP Development | Team Mentoring | Cross-functional Collaboration | SaaS | FinTech | Regulatory Compliance | Escalation Management | Customer Success | Account Management | CSM | Certified Scrum Master
raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Implementation Lead/ Project Manager Resulticks Edge Solutions Technologies Pvt. Ltd.
06/2025 – Present
Orchestrate day-to-day project operations including team scheduling, workload allocation, and quality oversight across high-complexity engagements.
Mentor and coach team members on best practices, serving as a role model; drove 15% improvement in team productivity through structured skill development.
Elevated client satisfaction by 20% through enhanced account management strategies and proactive communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Led Voice of Customer (VOC) analysis and implemented targeted improvement actions, achieving a 25% rise in customer satisfaction index.
Reduced customer complaints by 30% through strategic issue-specific action plans and process redesign. ● Resolved 90% of customer escalations through data-driven coaching and proactive stakeholder engagement. ● Delivered detailed account status reports to clients and senior management, ensuring transparency and timely issue resolution.
Implementation Lead Analyst FIS Global
10/2022 – 06/2025
Led complex implementation and conversion projects for banking and financial institutions within the FIS environment, managing end-to-end delivery timelines and cross-functional teams.

Identified complex mapping and interface requirements for unique conversion projects; examined data field conversion requirements to ensure seamless system transitions per FIS standards.
●
Implemented fraud management and fraud analysis tools for banking clients, improving operational efficiency, regulatory compliance, and card transaction processing integrity.
Applied advanced knowledge of FIS systems and banking industry relationships to design and modify application configurations as a strategic business partner.
Contributed to the development, documentation and implementation of standards, guidelines and process knowledge-base materials for the implementation team.
Participated in strategic planning discussions; brainstormed alternative approaches to complex conversion challenges in unstructured situations requiring independent judgement.
Team Lead Hexaware Technologies ( Client – Citi bank)
05/2019 – 09/2022
Led end-to-end delivery and transition of card/payment implementation projects, coordinating business, technology, testing and operations teams from initiation through implementation, readiness and BAU handover.
Collaborated with business stakeholders to gather requirements, define scope and drive project implementation through closure.
Owned RAID management for assigned workstreams, identifying risks, issues, assumptions and dependencies, defining mitigation actions, tracking owners and driving timely closure/escalation.
Coordinated operational readiness activities including process validation, documentation, UAT readiness, stakeholder sign-offs and production deployment, ensuring smooth transition to BAU support teams.
Prepared and maintained process documentation, operational procedures and knowledge-transfer materials to support transition and adoption by receiving operations teams.
Managed Agile delivery activities, including sprint backlogs, task prioritisation and backlog grooming.

Improved team efficiency by 15% through structured Agile coaching and process improvements.
Supported Commercial Card programmes, coordinating business and technology stakeholders across card operations, implementation and transition activities.
Senior Process Associate Tata Consultancy Services (TCS)
08/2014 – 05/2019
Coordinated with global clients via live calls and email to track project deliverables and resolve implementation issues across multiple banking and financial services projects.
Managed assigned Commercial Card workstreams, coordinating requirements, dependencies, testing, operational readiness and implementation activities across business and technology stakeholders.
Owned RAID management for assigned projects/workstreams, tracking risks, issues, assumptions, dependencies and actions; drove mitigation, follow-up and escalation to ensure timely resolution.
Developed and maintained detailed project plans covering scope, milestones, dependencies, resources, testing and implementation timelines, ensuring delivery remained aligned with agreed objectives.
Coordinated UAT/FUAT, readiness activities and business sign-offs prior to production implementation, ensuring operational and technology stakeholders were prepared for go-live.
Coordinated transition and handover to BAU/operations teams, ensuring required documentation, process knowledge and outstanding actions were completed and understood by receiving teams.
Managed delivery of card-related regulatory and business initiatives across Citi's APAC region, coordinating business, technology and testing stakeholders across multiple markets.
Prepared project status reports and governance updates covering milestones, risks, issues, dependencies and overall delivery status for regional stakeholders.
Managed user stories, sprint tracking and project documentation using Jira and Confluence.
Documented current-state and target-state operational processes and developed SOPs/process documentation to support implementation, transition and ongoing BAU operations.
Developed detailed L5/L6 process documentation and SOPs covering operational activities, controls, exceptions and transition requirements to support BAU adoption.
Conducted Agile retrospectives and implemented continuous improvement initiatives across delivery cycles, improving operational efficiency.
Associate – Banking Operations GE Capital Business Process Management Ltd.
09/2013 – 08/2014
● Managed SBI Cards operations using Vision Plus, overseeing card transaction lifecycle including disputes, credit
postings, and chargebacks with correct reason codes — core banking and payments domain expertise.
● Handled customer escalations via email with precise, timely communication; supported 24/7 operations through Delite
SharePoint.
Gained hands-on experience in payment card operations, fraud indicators, and banking dispute resolution processes.
Technical Support Executive C. Cubed Solutions Pvt. Ltd.
01/2013 – 07/2013
Served as first point of contact for all technical queries; diagnosed and resolved issues via remote access tools in a 24/7 environment.
Maintained CRM records and performed system optimization; managed hardware and network troubleshooting.
